rows.Kwic: 於過去迦葉佛時。曾住此山。因學人問。大修行底人還落因果。也無。某甲對云。不落因果。五百生墮野狐身。今請和尚。代一轉語

The unnamed old man and former abbot is the exact speaker recounting that he answered 'does not fall under cause and effect' and consequently endured five hundred births as a wild fox. Baizhang Huaihai supplies the requested turning word. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel passages do not name the old man.
